company_description: Cameco Corporation is a global leader in the uranium industry, active in exploration, mining, processing, and nuclear fuel manufacturing. It operates mines and processing facilities in Canada, the United States, and Australia, and holds strategic interests in enrichment and fuel manufacturing projects.

kpis.name: Uranium Production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of uranium produced from assets owned or operated by Cameco.

kpis.name: Uranium Sales
kpis.explanation: Volume of uranium sold to customers under long-term or spot contracts.

kpis.name: Average Uranium Sales Price
kpis.explanation: Average realized price per pound sold, reflecting the long-term contract/spot mix.

kpis.name: Unit Production Cost
kpis.explanation: Average production cost per pound of uranium, excluding general and administrative expenses.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation, amortization, and non-recurring items.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities before changes in working capital.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending to maintain and develop mining and industrial assets.

kpis.name: Proved and Probable Reserves
kpis.explanation: Economically recoverable uranium quantity under NI 43-101 standards.

kpis.name: Rising Uranium Price
kpis.description: Uranium prices reached a 10-year high, supported by structural supply shortages and growing demand for low-carbon nuclear power.

kpis.name: Full Restart of McArthur River
kpis.description: McArthur River, the world's highest-grade uranium mine, is fully operational following a phased restart.

kpis.name: Cigar Lake Performance
kpis.description: Cigar Lake operated near full capacity in 2024, solidifying its role as a production cornerstone.

kpis.name: New Long-Term Contract Signings
kpis.description: Cameco secured 15 Mlb under long-term contracts, ensuring revenue visibility and stability.

kpis.name: GLE Equity Stake
kpis.description: Cameco's 49% stake in Global Laser Enrichment provides access to more efficient and cost-effective uranium enrichment technology.

risks.description: Uranium price volatility may impact revenue predictability, despite partial long-term contract coverage.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, heightened language on volatility, upward trend but uncertainty remains, high economic model sensitivity to pricing.

risks.description: Delays or disruptions in deep underground mining operations (e.g., Cigar Lake) could affect production volumes and costs.
risks.score_rationale: Recurring mention in filings, cautious language, past incidents, and critical importance of mining assets.

risks.description: Changes in nuclear or environmental regulations could delay projects or increase compliance costs.
risks.score_rationale: Moderate placement in the filing, standard disclosure language, recent regulatory stability, but persistent structural risk.
